headline: Hashdex Nasdaq CME Crypto Index ETF Enters Agreement with Jane Street
summary: The Hashdex Nasdaq CME Crypto Index ETF entered into an agreement with Jane Street Capital.
why: Authorized participant and market maker agreements provide liquidity and support efficient creation and redemption mechanisms for exchange-traded funds.

impacts.name: Jane Street Group
impacts.why: New ETF partnerships enhance market-making capabilities and fund liquidity.
